note: The base level is fixed as a parameter of `echoes`/`arrives`, and the occupancy, separation and allowance facts enter as hypotheses; the derivation that distinct ancestral sites are at least B_i^2 apart at fine levels is not there.

lemma echoes (a:B.Mode): ‖pilot C d s p N o g a-Cresting C d s p N j o g a‖ ≤ refreeze C.path.levels p k x y a Z/(brisk (P j).B/2):=by
    let F:= seed C d s p N o g; let f:=harp C d s p N o g; let φ':=chill C d s p N o g
    let J:= Accent.birth B (Q N) F; have ht : k ≤ N:= (hf.trans hV).le
    obtain ⟨G',H,Hg⟩:= hh.past C d N k p W u ψ φ δ ζ r D s o g Z h hs he ht hx hy hz hM hw -- hG syntax. implicit.

proof_context.conclusion: `echoes` fixes a base level `k` with `k <= N`, `k < j`, and obtains the base-level data (occupancy, separation `Drake`, positive allowances) from its hypotheses via `hh.past`.
`arrives` takes the base level `r` above the reference levels and fixes the allowances `ζ` used for the weights.
